errors.somethingWrongText: This page could not be shown. Try again, and if the problem stays, reload the page.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFoundText: The page you are looking for does not exist or was moved.
errors.serverText: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.loadFailed: The data could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

upload.dropOrBrowse: Click to choose a file, or drop it here
upload.invalidType: This file type is not allowed. Use: {{types}}.
upload.tooLarge: The file is too large (maximum {{max}} MB).

validation.nameMin: The name must have at least 2 characters
validation.nameMax: The name must have at most 100 characters
validation.passwordMax: The password is too long (72 bytes at most)
validation.amountFormat: Enter an amount with at most 2 decimals, for example 12.50
validation.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero

auth.name: Full name
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to your email.
auth.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
auth.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetSubtitle: Use a strong password you do not use elsewhere.
auth.invalidLinkText: The reset link is missing or incomplete.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Organize your income and expenses.
categories.name: Name
categories.typeLocked: The type cannot be changed after the category is created.
categories.emptyText: Create your own categories for the things you track. The default ones are always available.
categories.deleteText: "{{name}}" will be deleted. A category that is used by transactions cannot be deleted.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Your cash, bank accounts, cards and savings in one place.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingBalanceHint: What the account holds today. Use a minus sign for a negative balance.
accounts.fixedFields: The currency ({{currency}}) and the balance cannot be edited here. The balance changes only through transactions and transfers.
accounts.totalHint: Each currency is added up on its own. Nothing is converted.
accounts.emptyText: Add your first account to start tracking where your money is.
accounts.deleteText: "{{name}}" will be deleted. An account that has transactions, recurring items or transfers cannot be deleted: archive it instead.
accounts.deleteBlocked: "{{name}}" has transactions, recurring items or transfers, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
accounts.transferNeedTwo: A transfer needs two active accounts with the same currency.
accounts.amountHint: In {{currency}}. Both accounts must use the same currency.
accounts.transfersEmptyText: Money you move between your accounts shows up here.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Track where your money goes.
expenses.amountHint: In {{currency}}, the currency of the account.
expenses.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas. Up to 10 tags of 30 characters.
expenses.tagLong: A tag can have at most 30 characters
expenses.receiptWillBeRemoved: The receipt will be removed when you save.
expenses.receiptFailed: The expense was saved, but the receipt could not be updated. Edit the expense to try again.
expenses.receiptLoadFailed: The receipt could not be loaded.
expenses.needAccountText: An expense is taken from an account. Add one, then come back.
expenses.deleteText: This expense of {{amount}} will be deleted and the amount goes back to {{account}}.
expenses.emptyText: Add your first expense to see where your money goes.
expenses.noResultsText: Try other words or filters, or clear them.
expenses.rangeInvalid: The minimum must not be greater than the maximum

income.title: Income
income.subtitle: Track the money that comes in.
income.sourceHint: Who paid you, for example an employer or a client.
income.amountHint: In {{currency}}, the currency of the account.
income.needAccountText: Income is added to an account. Add one, then come back.
income.deleteText: This income of {{amount}} will be deleted and the amount is taken back from {{account}}.
income.emptyText: Add your first income to see what comes in.
income.noResultsText: Try other words or filters, or clear them.
income.rangeInvalid: The minimum must not be greater than the maximum

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: Set monthly spending limits and see how much you have used.
budgets.categoryHint: Pick a category, or the overall budget for all spending.
budgets.alertThresholdHint: You get an alert when this share of the limit is used.
budgets.thresholdInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100
budgets.deleteText: The {{name}} budget of {{amount}} for {{month}} will be deleted. Your expenses are not changed.
budgets.emptyText: Add a budget to keep your spending under control.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.subtitle: Schedules that add expenses and income for you automatically.
recurring.formNote: This is a schedule. Saving it does not change any balance; transactions are created on their due dates.
recurring.fixedNote: The type, frequency and start date cannot be changed. Delete this schedule and create a new one for that.
recurring.amountHint: In {{currency}}, the currency of the account.
recurring.startDateHint: Past dates are skipped: the first run is the first date from today.
recurring.endDateHint: Optional. Leave empty to repeat without an end.
recurring.endBeforeStart: The end date must not be before the start date
recurring.endBeforeNextRun: The end date must not be before the next run date
recurring.archivedAccountHint: The account {{account}} is archived. Restore it before you resume this schedule.
recurring.deleteText: The schedule {{name}} of {{amount}} will be deleted. Transactions it already created are kept.
recurring.needAccountText: A schedule adds money to or takes it from an account. Add one, then come back.
recurring.emptyText: Add rent, a salary or a subscription once and it is recorded for you.
recurring.noResultsText: Try other filters, or clear them.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome back, {{name}}. Here is your money at a glance.
dashboard.customHint: Choose both dates to see the numbers.
dashboard.rangeInvalid: The end date must not be before the start date.
dashboard.rangeTooLong: The date range is too long (5 years at most).
dashboard.recentEmptyText: Add an expense or an income in {{currency}} and it will show up here.
dashboard.chartLabel: Bar chart of income and expenses over time in {{currency}}
dashboard.chartEmptyText: Income and expenses will be drawn here once you add some.
dashboard.categoryEmptyText: Your biggest spending categories will show up here.
dashboard.budgetEmptyText: Set a limit for a category to keep an eye on your spending.
